NVIDIA Pascal-Generation Documentation Archive
================================================
Destination: C:\nvidia_docs\
Downloaded: 2026-08-16
Source: All files pulled directly from official NVIDIA / docs.nvidia.com URLs.
         Every PDF was verified to have a valid %PDF magic header.

SCOPE
-----
Everything directly Pascal-related (compute capability 6.x: GP100 sm_60,
GP104/GP102 sm_61, GP106/107/108 sm_62), plus the CUDA programming docs
that contain the official CUDA code examples and the PTX ISA covering
the Pascal targets. Two parallel sets are included:
  * "current" docs (latest CUDA, still accurately describe Pascal)
  * "archive_cuda8" docs (CUDA 8.0 -- the toolkit Pascal launched with,
    the most period-accurate reference for the generation)

NOTES
-----
* "Dynamic Parallelism" is no longer a standalone PDF; it is now a chapter
  of the CUDA C Programming Guide (included above).
* Whitepapers are the authoritative GP100/GP104 hardware architecture
  references; the Tuning/Compatibility guides are the software-facing ones.
* For absolute period accuracy on Pascal, prefer the archive_cuda8/ set,
  which matches the CUDA 8.0 toolchain that shipped with the generation.
* The earlier cuda_programming/CUDA_GPUs_Compute_Capability.html is the
  CURRENT (non-legacy) NVIDIA page and no longer lists Pascal. The legacy/
  page above is the authoritative Pascal (compute capability 6.x) device list.
* The CUDA Occupancy Calculator XLS is deprecated by NVIDIA; the PDF in
  occupancy/ is the supported replacement and covers compute capabilities
  through 8.6, including Pascal 6.0/6.1/6.2.
* The DGX-1 User Guide PDF covers both Pascal (P100) and Volta (V100)
  configurations; the Pascal-relevant sections are the P100 / NVLink material.
